headline: Weathered Expanse Contested as Colonials Reclaim Fisherman's Row
war_summary: Bitter fighting across the Weathered Expanse shows no sign of slackening, where two fresh base upheavals inside the past two hours have reduced another stronghold to neutral ruin and locked the sector in a tense four-four standoff. To the west, Colonials have completely reclaimed Fisherman's Row, consolidating all nine strategic bases and extinguishing the earlier island tumult. Along the Stlican Shelf, Warden forces widened their grasp to an eight-to-one margin before combat slowed to a crawl after daybreak. Attrition has reached savage heights in Callahan's Passage and Mooring County, where enlistments surge and casualties accelerate at well over seven hundred men per hour, even as frontline borders hold firm. Stonecradle remains heavily contested under a fragile five-to-four Warden balance, marked by quickening skirmishes around World's End. By contrast, the guns have largely quieted across Dead Lands and Godcrofts, leaving both hexes firmly under Colonial administration.
